fields.name: user_accessibility_goal
fields.prompt: What accessibility support were you trying to accomplish with AI?

fields.name: user_why
fields.prompt: Why were you seeking this support? (e.g., to navigate communication norms, expectations, accessibility barriers)

fields.name: user_how_strategy
fields.prompt: What were you trying to adjust?
options: It was not my goal to adjust my communication style
It was not my goal to adjust my self-expression

fields.name: user_how_strategy_other
fields.prompt: If Other, please describe.

fields.name: user_wanted_ai
fields.prompt: What were you hoping the AI would do in this moment?

fields.name: user_adjustment_matter
fields.prompt: Why did this adjustment matter to you?

fields.name: user_where
fields.prompt: In what communication context was this?

fields.name: user_where_other
fields.prompt: If Other, please describe.

fields.name: user_instance_description
fields.prompt: In this instance, which best describes what happened?
options: I adjusted myself so the AI could work better or understand me better
I used AI to help me adjust how I communicate, behave, or present myself to someone else
The AI automatically adjusted how I communicate, behave, or present myself

fields.name: user_benefits_challenges
fields.prompt: Please describe any additional benefits or challenges you experienced during this interaction. This may include how this interaction made you feel.

fields.name: user_additional_explanation
fields.prompt: Is there anything else you would like to explain about this interaction?

fields.name: ai_behavior
fields.prompt: What did AI do in this highlighted passage?
options: Suggested changes to my communication but did not modify it
Suggested changes to my communication that were helpful
Suggested changes to my communication that were not helpful
Did not provide the support I requested
Changed or took out important meanings in my message

fields.name: ai_behavior_explanation
fields.prompt: How did this compare with what you wanted?

fields.name: ai_benefits
fields.prompt: What, if anything, did AI do particularly well in helping you communicate the way you wanted?
options: I think it decreased social risks (e.g., discrimination, prejudice)
I did not experience any benefits

fields.name: ai_benefits_other
fields.prompt: If Other, please describe.

fields.name: ai_challenges
fields.prompt: What, if anything, did AI do particularly poorly in helping you communicate the way you wanted?
options: I did not experience any challenges

fields.name: ai_challenges_other
fields.prompt: If Other, please describe.

fields.name: ai_outcome_explanation
fields.prompt: How would you have liked the AI to support you differently in this interaction?

fields.name: ai_would_respond_differently
fields.prompt: Would you have wanted AI to respond differently? If so, what should it have done, and why?

fields.name: ai_followup_adjustment
fields.prompt: What did you do after this response, if anything?
options: I re-prompted the AI to change it

fields.name: ai_followup_explanation
fields.prompt: What prompted this action, and did it require extra effort?

fields.name: conversation_accessibility_context
fields.prompt: What accessibility support were you trying to accomplish with AI?

fields.name: conversation_additional_context
fields.prompt: Is there anything important about your communication preferences or experience that is not visible in the conversation?

legacy_fields.name: legacy_ai_behavior
options: Preserved my intended language or expression
Helped organize or structure my communication
Introduced assumptions about me or my communication
Did not provide the support I requested

legacy_fields.name: legacy_ai_challenges
options: Did not account for my accessibility needs

legacy_fields.name: legacy_ai_followup_adjustment
options: I intended to but did not
